title: Chickenpox contact in pregnancy
stem: Cubicle 4. Mrs Chow is 16 weeks pregnant. Four days ago she spent the afternoon with her nephew, who now has chickenpox. She has never had chickenpox as far as she knows. She is worried. Assess her and advise her.
notes:
Checked against RCOG Green-top Guideline 13 (Chickenpox in pregnancy, 2015), the UKHSA Green Book chapter 34 and UKHSA guidance on post-exposure prophylaxis (updated 2019 onward), and the Hong Kong Centre for Health Protection guidance.

Significant exposure: household contact, face-to-face for 5 minutes, or 15 minutes in the same room with chickenpox or exposed shingles. Check immunity: a clear history of chickenpox is usually enough; if uncertain, urgent VZV IgG.

Post-exposure prophylaxis for non-immune pregnant women: UKHSA (since 2019) recommends oral aciclovir 800 mg four times daily from day 7 to day 14 after exposure as first line, with VZIG reserved for those who cannot take aciclovir; HK practice may still use VZIG within 10 days — follow local guidance. She is infectious from 8 to 28 days after exposure (to 21 days without VZIG) and should avoid other pregnant women and neonates.

If chickenpox develops: oral aciclovir within 24 hours of the rash if 20 weeks or more (consider before 20 weeks); urgent review for chest symptoms, neurological symptoms, haemorrhagic rash or dense rash (pneumonia risk about 10%). Fetal varicella syndrome risk is about 1–2% before 20 weeks; neonatal varicella if maternal infection is within about 5 days before to 2 days after delivery.

Your notes use VZIG 125 units per 10 kg (US dosing, max 625) as PEP; UK guidance now uses aciclovir first. The rest of your notes (exposure definition, risks, measles PEP with immunoglobulin within 6 days) matches.

steps.label: History
steps.hint: Nature and date of the exposure, immunity, symptoms, pregnancy details.

Exposure.t: When did you see your nephew, and for how long?
Exposure.tz: 你幾時見過你外甥？見咗幾耐？
Exposure.rz: 禮拜六，四日前，成個下晝喺屋企入面玩。第二朝佢就出疹。
Exposure.r: Saturday, 4 days ago, the whole afternoon playing indoors. His spots came out the next morning.
Exposure.mark: Establishes significant exposure and its date

Exposure.t: Has he got chickenpox or shingles?

Immunity.t: Have you ever had chickenpox or the vaccine?
Immunity.tz: 你以前有冇出過水痘，或者打過水痘針？
Immunity.r: My mother isn't sure. I don't think so.
Immunity.mark: Asks about previous chickenpox or vaccination

Now.t: Any rash, fever, cough or breathlessness?
Now.tz: 你有冇出疹、發燒、咳，或者氣促？

Now.t: How is the pregnancy going? Any other health problems, smoking?
Now.tz: 懷孕進展點？有冇其他健康問題？有冇食煙？
Now.rz: 到目前為止都正常。我唔食煙。
Now.r: All normal so far. I don't smoke.
Now.mark: Pregnancy details and risk factors (smoking raises pneumonia risk)

steps.label: Advise
steps.hint: Explain, PEP, infectious period, what to watch for, follow-up.

opts.t: Most babies are fine. If you did catch chickenpox before 20 weeks, the chance of the baby being affected is about 1 to 2 in 100. We can reduce your chance of catching it.
opts.tz: 大部分BB都冇事。就算你喺二十週之前真係出咗水痘，BB受影響嘅機會大概係每一百個有一至兩個。我哋可以減低你感染嘅機會。
opts.mark: Explains fetal risk honestly with numbers

opts.t: Antiviral tablets (aciclovir) from day 7 to day 14 after the contact, which lower the chance of chickenpox. Some hospitals use an antibody injection instead; we'll follow the obstetric team's advice.
opts.tz: 喺接觸後第七至第十四日食抗病毒藥（aciclovir），可以減低出水痘嘅機會。有啲醫院會改打抗體針；我哋會跟產科團隊嘅建議。
opts.mark: Offers post-exposure prophylaxis per current guidance

turns.line: Should I stay away from anyone?

opts.t: You could be infectious from 8 to 28 days after the contact, so avoid other pregnant women and newborn babies then. If you get a rash, call us at once — not the waiting room — so we can start treatment within 24 hours. Come immediately with any cough, breathlessness or headache.
opts.tz: 接觸後第八至第二十八日你都可能有傳染性，嗰段時間要避開其他孕婦同初生BB。如果出疹，即刻打電話俾我哋——唔好直接嚟坐喺候診室——等我哋可以喺二十四個鐘內開始治療。如果有咳、氣促或者頭痛，要即刻嚟。
opts.mark: Advises on infectious period and safety-nets

qs.q: UK first-line PEP for a non-immune pregnant woman after chickenpox exposure?
wrong: Varicella vaccine within 3 days of contact
No prophylaxis unless a rash appears

qs.q: Risk of fetal varicella syndrome before 20 weeks?
Maternal complication of chickenpox in pregnancy?

wrong: Given at 28 weeks alongside routine anti-D

qs.q: Measles exposure in a non-immune pregnant woman?
wrong: MMR vaccine within 72 hours of the exposure
Oral aciclovir from day 7 to day 14

cards.q: Chickenpox in a pregnant woman over 20 weeks presenting within 24 h of rash:
Non-immune pregnant contact is potentially infectious…
cards.why: Avoid other pregnant women and neonates.

cards.q: Neonatal varicella risk is highest if maternal rash appears…
options: 5 days before to 2 days after delivery

cards.q: UK PEP for VZV in pregnancy changed (2019) to…
options: Aciclovir first line; VZIG if unsuitable
VZIG for all non-immune women within 10 days
MMR vaccine within 72 hours, then a second dose
